# YominPost

> YominPost is an open-source (MIT), self-hosted AI social media studio. One piece of material (text, URL or images) becomes platform-native posts: a rule-based router picks the format per platform (text, thread, image post, carousel, short video), a content engine writes hook/body/CTA/hashtags, a QA step scores and rewrites once, and a pre-publish risk gate catches signals that get AI-assisted accounts restricted. Real OAuth2 + PKCE connectors schedule and publish. It ships as a FastAPI web app, a CLI (`yominpost`), an MCP server (`yominpost-mcp`) for Claude Code / Cursor, and an agent skill (SKILL.md). Zero config: no API keys required (offline template driver by default), data in ~/.yominpost/.

Author: Yomin Ma (https://yomin.love, https://x.com/HEee1850894). Repository: https://github.com/mrlong0129/yominpost

## What it does

- 8-slot content engine: brand DNA → trends → ideation & calendar → format router (explainable rules) → copy → visual (SVG/JPG poster, optional gpt-image) → short-video storyboard + SRT → QA self-critique.
- Post Creating Loop: material → analysis → research → strategy → one draft per channel on an infinite canvas with chat refinement.
- Drivers: template (offline, default), claude_code (local claude CLI), codex (local codex CLI), agy, anthropic (API); automatic fallback chain.
- Real publishing: X, LinkedIn, Reddit, Facebook Page, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Discord, Mastodon (self-registering app), Telegram, Bluesky, Webhook. Simulated: TikTok, Xiaohongshu, Threads, Pinterest.
- Pre-publish risk gate: prompt leak, engagement bait, hashtag/link limits, duplicate detection, per-platform cadence caps, auto-freeze after a platform block.
- Operations: calendar, scheduled queue with retry, asset library, topic bank, per-channel health, daily channel sync, backups.
- Security: Fernet-encrypted tokens, operator access key (mandatory for public deploys), SSRF-guarded fetching.

## MCP tools

- generate_posts(brand, material, platforms, num_topics, trends, language)
- check_post(text, platform, hashtags)
- save_draft(text, title, hook, cta, hashtags, platforms)
- list_posts(status, limit)
- list_platforms()
- No publish tool by design: a human approves publishing in the web UI.

## Quick start

- Studio: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/mrlong0129/yominpost yominpost --open` (http://127.0.0.1:8300)
- CLI: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/mrlong0129/yominpost yominpost run --brand Acme --source "..." --platform x --platform linkedin --json`
- MCP (Claude Code): `claude mcp add yominpost -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/mrlong0129/yominpost yominpost-mcp`
